pattern: mixed fields use a real thread form
experience: Owner requested usable mixed forms instead of a prose questionnaire.
prompt: Ask me to fill out one form for a team lunch: name as text, number of guests from 1 to 12, morning or afternoon as a select, food preferences as multiple choices, a reminder toggle and optional multiline notes. Use actual form controls, not a questionnaire in prose.

pattern: private secrets never enter ordinary forms
experience: Owner requires secrets to stay on the existing private secret route.
prompt: I need to give you an API token privately. Show the private input so the token never appears in the thread.
